source.title: Benefits and Harms of Sodium-Glucose Co-Transporter 2 Inhibitors in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is optimized for primary literature and has no dedicated systematic_review/meta_analysis atom kind. Pooled estimates generated by this review are represented with existing quantitative_result/adverse_event/subgroup_result kinds and descriptive tags; underlying individual trial results are not represented as if generated by this review.
limitations: Extraction is source-grounded to the supplied article and supplements. Model-assisted atoms remain needs_review. No external verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
